articles.title_en: Ukrainian drone crashes on beach with vacationers at Russian Black Sea resort as warning system fails to sound. Seven people killed.
articles.lead_en: Six people, including three children, were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on the village of Arkhipo-Osipovka near Gelendzhik, Krasnodar Krai Governor Veniamin Kondratyev said.

articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones attack Russia’s Black Sea coast and occupied Crimea, killing six people
articles.lead_en: A Ukrainian drone attack on occupied Crimea killed three people and injured two others, said Sergey Aksyonov, the Kremlin-appointed head of the peninsula. He reported no other damage from the strikes.
